people.imagined: Evening in his own bare hall. He sits on the stone floor because chairs break, one knee up, the red banner furled across his lap. He has just been told another letter came from the Fire Court and is deciding not to read it yet. The vent glows behind him.
people.subject: The moment: in the evening in his bare stone hall he sits cross-legged, a furled banner across his thighs, looking straight at the viewer with his chin lowered, deciding not to read a letter yet. Face (most important: the arms and neck are glossy red): a broad square face with a heavy jaw, a short thick bull neck and skin burned to a smooth glossy red from the jaw down and across both shoulders, shining like polished brick; above the jaw the face is weathered brown; a flat nose bent once, thick black brows, small dark eyes with deep creases at the corners, a short black stubble beard. Hair: black, cropped close to the skull with a few white hairs above the ears, crowned with a small red-jade crown. Body: enormously broad, thick through chest and upper arms, the bare arms white with countless thin pale scar lines from wrist to shoulder. Clothing: the head's richest dress: a sleeveless over-robe of crimson brocade worked with gold flames, hanging off one shoulder over an ember-red gauze under-robe with two crossed collars, a wide crimson silk sash wound three times round the waist, its tail in his lap, embroidered with flames. Hands and objects: both big hands rest on a furled crimson silk banner with a long cloud-shaped end, plain; a finger-long red-orange jade feather hangs at his throat on a silk cord. Power: a heavy aura of ember-red heat rolls off his shoulders, glowing sparks drifting upward. Background: dark stone hall with the orange glow of a vent through a doorway. Light: warm spirit-light from the vent rims his shoulders, soft haze of heat. Expression: patient and heavy, the mouth set, a hint of forgiveness in the eyes.

people.imagined: He is bent over a weiqi board on a flat sitting stone after the day's sitting, a black stone between two fingers. He tilts his head because he is listening to the vent through the floor, not to the person who has just spoken.
people.subject: The moment: after the day's sitting he sits at a weiqi board on a flat stone, tilting his head with one ear toward the ground, a black stone held above the board, listening to the vent through the floor. Face (most important: the head tilt, and skin burned shiny and smooth): a compact round-jawed face, skin shiny and smooth as glazed pottery on cheeks and forehead, without wrinkles; no eyebrows to speak of, only a faint grey line; narrow grey-brown eyes that look past the viewer; a flat nose, a thin patient mouth. Hair: grey, cropped to a quarter inch, bristling, held by a small dark-red jade band. Body: short, dense and square, thick forearms. Clothing: an elder's sleeveless over-robe of dark-red brocade with stitched flame borders over ember silk under-robes with two crossed collars, the bare arms pale white with fine scar lines from wrist to shoulder, a dark-red silk sash with a red jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a black round weiqi stone between index and middle finger; the left rests on a square wooden board with a fine grid and a few black and white stones; a dull iron ring thick as a thumb on his left fist. Power: a faint ember-red glow gathers over the board, tiny sparks hanging in the air near his ear. Background: dark cave wall in mist with a soft orange glow on one side. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left on the board and his hands. Expression: calm, patient, calculating; the slight smile of a man who has already seen the next move.

people.imagined: She stands on the vent's flank at night, counting. In her left hand a cord with knots, her thumb on the last knot. The sulphur has dusted her hair and shoulders grey.
people.subject: The moment: at night on the vent's flank she holds a long knotted cord in both hands and looks down at it, then up at the viewer, her thumb on one knot. Face: a long, calm oval face, skin dusted grey-yellow with sulphur at the brows and hairline; deep-set dark eyes with faint red rims from the fumes; high cheekbones; a straight mouth, lips slightly cracked; no ornament. Hair: black streaked with grey, dusted pale, in a single braid down the front of her left shoulder, tied with a strip of red silk and held at the crown by a small red-jade pin. Body: slim and upright, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a dark-red silk over-vest cut high at the neck with flame-embroidered edges, worn over layered ember gauze with two crossed collars, bare forearms pale with a few fine scar lines, a red silk sash with a jade pendant; over her shoulders a pale grey translucent gauze shawl dusted with sulphur. Hands and objects: a hemp cord as long as her arm with about forty knots, some clean and tight, three untied loops hanging loose; her thumb pressed on one knot. Power: a soft ember-red aura, motes of orange light rising from the cord. Background: dark rock, a glow of orange in a crack below, drifting yellow sulphur mist. Light: orange from below left, cool blue moonlight from the upper left. Expression: composed, devout, the faint weariness of a person who keeps count.

people.imagined: On the palace road at midday, he has just spat into the dust at the sight of the envoy's banner. He wears a merchant's good coat because he never stopped, with the hall's red sash over it.
people.subject: The moment: on the palace road at midday he glares sideways at something off-frame, jaw pushed forward, a breath from spitting into the dust at an envoy's banner. Face (most important: the nose, smashed flat and bent hard to the left): a wide, red-cheeked face with a loud shouting mouth, a thick black moustache, heavy brows drawn together over bright dark eyes, and the flattened nose that makes every scowl lopsided. Hair: thick black hair tied back in a short tail with a red silk cord and a red-jade bead. Body: thick-chested with heavy shoulders, a big man gone broad, planted wide on the road. Clothing: a wine-coloured silk coat with wide flowing sleeves and gold-thread flame borders, kept from his trading days and worn open over layered ember gauze, two collars crossed loosely over a bare chest; a broad crimson silk sash of the hall tied at the waist with a heavy knot, a jade pendant swinging; the left sleeve pushed up to show a scarred forearm. Hands and objects: one fist planted on his hip; in the other hand a short levy officer's baton of dark lacquered wood with a red tassel. Power: a hot ember-red haze shimmers around his shoulders and fist, a few sparks lifting. Background: a misty road, a low line of hills, a pale luminous sky. Light: hard, bright spirit-light from the upper left, strong shadows under brows and nose, a red rim light. Expression: a wrathful, belligerent scowl, the mouth set in a sneer, nostrils flared, not a trace of a smile.

people.imagined: At the dark of the moon at the Lower Mouth, she holds the cord and shows her left palm to someone who doubts her. The lamp is shaded; she is lying calmly.
people.subject: The moment: in lamplight at the dark of the moon she holds up her open left hand toward the viewer, palm out, showing a pale cord scar, calmly lying to someone who doubts her. Face: a round, quick, friendly face with olive skin, a small snub nose, a mole under the right eye, wide brown eyes that hold a little too steady, and a small mouth with one corner lifted. Hair: black, in two high round buns on top tied with red silk cord and small red-jade pins. Body: small, sturdy and round-shouldered, standing close to the lamp. Clothing: a short sleeveless red silk over-robe with a stiff standing collar and ember embroidery at the hem, over layered gauze with two crossed collars, bare arms with two faint scar lines, a red silk sash with a short tail and a small jade pendant. Hands and objects (the scar is the lead, big and plain): the left palm raised open at shoulder height, a milk-white raised scar a finger wide running straight across it from the base of the index finger to the heel of the hand; the right hand grips the end of a hemp cord that runs out of frame. Power: a faint ember-orange glow in the palm and a few motes around her hair. Background: dark vent rock in mist, a shaded lantern on a hook, moonless dark beyond. Light: a small warm spirit-lamp from the lower right lights her chin and open palm, the rest falls into dark with a soft rim. Expression: an open, friendly face and a steady, easy smile that holds a lie without a flicker, calm eyes, no sign of strain.

people.imagined: He is weighing a sack of charcoal at a beam scale, his thumb pressed on the beam while his face shows nothing. White stone dust clings to his brows and shoulders.
people.subject: The moment: he presses his thumb on the arm of a hanging beam scale while looking innocently at the viewer, as if nothing is happening. Face (most important: the brows, thick and chalk-white with stone dust): a lean, narrow face with a long nose and a mouth pulled thin, small shrewd grey eyes, hollow cheeks, deep lines at the mouth filled with fine pale dust, pale dry skin dusted with red-white powder at the hairline. Hair: thin grey hair slicked back under a small dark-red silk cap with a jade clasp. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, stooped a little over his work. Clothing: a steward's long robe of dark brown silk with sleeves rolled once, layered over ember gauze with two collars crossed, the collar stitched carefully with red thread and flame-pattern borders, the hall's red silk sash at his waist hung with a small jade tally. Hands and objects: a wooden beam scale hangs from a cord, a black sack of charcoal on one pan and a small iron weight on the other; his right thumb tucked under the beam. Power: a faint ember glimmer in the dust drifting about him. Background: stacked charcoal sacks and a heap of dull-red stones in drifting mist, a low wall of red-brown stone behind. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left, a thin bar of glowing dust-filled light across his shoulder where the dust glitters like powdered rust. Expression: a cautious, cunning look, the mouth perfectly straight while the eyes are quietly pleased with themselves, a man who has never been caught.

people.imagined: He holds up a handful of straws at a road post, the short one bent between his fingers, and has already chosen the man he dislikes.
people.subject: The moment: at a roadside post he holds out a closed fist with several straw ends showing and offers the viewer a choice, with a stubborn half-smile. Face (most important: the left ear is missing its lobe, a clean notch edged with a thin pink scar): a square brown face with a heavy chin, a short flat nose, a squinting left eye, a wide mouth in a lopsided smile and black stubble; the right ear whole, with a single gold ring in its rim. Hair: black, short and unkempt, bound by a red silk headband with a small red-jade bead. Body: tough, thick-armed, medium height, weight on one leg. Clothing: a sleeveless brown-red silk over-robe with flame borders over layered dark ember gauze with two collars crossed, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a red silk sash knotted at his belly, a bound wrist guard on the right forearm; across his chest a silk strap hung with small wooden road-post tokens and a jade pendant; four pale scars on his left forearm. Hands and objects: the right fist closed round the ends of five dry straw stalks, one plainly bent shorter; the left thumb hooked in his sash. Power: a thin ember glow around his fist and a few drifting sparks. Background: a roadside post of grey wood, a misty slope, a track running into brown grassland, far smoke of a vent on the horizon. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, his shadow long across the road, straws casting thin lines on his knuckles. Expression: a shut, lopsided half-smile of stubborn confidence, eyes bright with the pleasure of being the one who decides.

people.imagined: She is about to read a name aloud in a dark cave mouth, but first she coughs into her sleeve, covering her mouth with the red cloth.
people.subject: The moment: she lifts a wide sleeve to her mouth in a cough, eyes watching the viewer above it, just before reading a name aloud at a dark cave mouth. Face: a thin, pale, scholarly face with hollow cheeks, dark circles under the eyes, a long straight nose, thin brows lifted slightly in worry, chapped and faintly bluish lips, and a cough-flushed spot high on each cheekbone. Hair: black, in a tight low knot at the nape held by a white-jade pin, a few wisps stuck to the damp forehead. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered, stooped over her papers. Clothing: a long flowing dark-red silk robe with loose wide sleeves that hide her hands, layered over ember gauze with three crossed collars edged in flame embroidery, a narrow red sash with a jade pendant; ink stains on the right cuff; the sleeve she coughs into is paler from long wiping. Hands and objects: the left sleeve raised to cover her mouth; the right hand holds a long bundle of narrow bamboo slips tied with red silk cord against her chest, plain and unmarked. Power: a thin, tired ember glow in the sleeve folds, a few motes in the lamplight. Background: a dim cave mouth, wet black basalt streaked with orange vent glow, a rope handrail vanishing into the dark, a hanging spirit-lamp. Light: a dim warm lamp from the upper left, deep shadow beyond, dust motes and a thin drift of sulphur mist rising through the circle of light. Expression: a watchful, cautious look with a faint honest worry in the lifted brows, eyes steady over the sleeve.

people.imagined: He sits on the hot rock after a bout, knuckles on his knees, still thinking about the question someone asked a moment ago.
people.subject: The moment: he sits very still on hot rock after a bout with his heavy fists on his knees and his eyes a half-beat late, staring dully at the viewer, still working out a question someone asked a moment ago. Face (most important: the knuckles, flat and ground smooth as river stones, grey-white and shiny): a broad flat face with a low forehead, small close-set eyes under heavy lids, a thick neck, a nose broken twice, a slack mouth half open, thick cauliflowered ears on both sides, and a long old white scar from the corner of the left eye down into the stubble. Hair: coarse black hair cut short, a plain red silk band round it. Body: very wide and slope-shouldered, heavy forearms, a block of a man. Clothing: a sleeveless brown-red silk over-robe with simple flame borders over plain ember gauze with two collars, bare arms with flat pale scars, a wrist-wrap of dark silk on each arm black with sweat, a red silk sash wound four times round the waist, thick as a rope. Hands and objects: both fists laid on his knees in clear view, no weapon. Power: a low red-orange heat shimmer rises off his shoulders. Background: dark vent rock in mist with a warm orange haze at the left, stone steps leading down to a platform with a bucket and dipper. Light: warm glow from the upper left, heat shimmer wavering above the rock, his shadow short and square. Expression: a dull, heavy stare, the mouth slack, brow furrowed with slow effort, a latent anger he has not yet found a reason for.

people.imagined: She walks past with her hand in a pocket and the lead filings shake like seeds; she stops to weigh a stone carefully and glances back.
people.subject: The moment: she holds a small brass scale up at chest height and looks sharply at the viewer, as if daring them to dispute the weight. Face: a long, narrow, serious face with a high forehead, level straight brows, wary narrowed dark eyes, a sharp chin, a pinched, honest mouth. A small old burn mark the size of a thumbnail on her right cheek; short dark lashes. Hair: black, parted in the middle, pinned in a tight flat coil at the back with a silver pin. Body: lean, tall, straight-backed. Clothing: graceful but spare: a sleeveless red silk over-robe with narrow flame borders over a fine brown gauze under-robe with two crossed collars and long sleeves buttoned at the wrist and pinned up with silver pins; a red silk sash hung with a jade pendant and a small pouch of grey grit; across the front a long row of narrow silk pockets each holding a small lead weight. Hands and objects: a small hand balance of brass with two flat pans in her right hand, a dull-red stone on one pan and a lead weight on the other, level; her left hand pressed to the pocket at her hip. Power: a faint pale metal-white shimmer plays along the brass. Background: stacked red stones on a rough table in soft mist, a neat row of stone samples from pale pink to deep brick red. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left glinting off the brass, a small lamp at her elbow adding a gold edge. Expression: a tight, straight mouth and sharp, narrowed eyes, brows drawn slightly together, challenging any dispute of the weight.

people.imagined: At the Lower Mouth on a moonless night she stands guard; someone has asked who came down the rock, and she answers 'a dream' in her gravel voice, her hand held out for the rice.
people.subject: The moment: on a moonless night she stands in the dark with a palm held out flat toward the viewer, asking to be paid, her mouth open to answer low in a gravel voice. Face: a hard young face with high flat cheekbones, a square jaw, narrow black eyes with a glint, a small scar through the left eyebrow, cracked lips, a wide mouth with a thin upper lip, cords standing in the neck, a small hollow that dimples the left cheek when she half-smiles. Hair: black, cut at the jaw, a red silk cord tied round the head. Body: wiry and forward-leaning, ready to move. Clothing: a sleeveless dark-red silk over-robe cut to the thigh with a darker flame-stitched border, over ember gauze with two crossed collars, a wide red silk sash tied with a flat square knot over the left hip with a small jade pendant, bare arms with scar lines and a dark silk-bound bracer on the left forearm. Hands and objects: the right palm out and open at chest height; in the left hand a short iron-shod staff held against her shoulder. Power: faint ember motes cling to her arms and drift upward with the sparks. Background: night, tall dark rock walls on both sides in mist, a low orange glow from a crack at the left base. Light: orange spirit-glow from the lower left runs along her jaw and the iron shoe of the staff; cold dark elsewhere with a thin red rim. Expression: a hungry, sly look, one eyebrow cocked and the half-smile ready, loyal but always counting what she is owed.

people.imagined: At dusk he kneels over the same bundle, tying and untying it again, the ash from the palace still grey in its folds; he looks up when someone passes.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk he kneels over an open cloth bundle, hands in the middle of retying it, and glances up at the viewer with a quick wide smile. Face: a young open face, round with a rough chin, quick friendly brown eyes, thick expressive brows, one a little higher than the other with a small scar through the left, ash-grey smudges across the left cheek, a snub nose and a gap between the front teeth. Hair: dark brown, sticking up, tied in a tuft with a bit of red thread. Body: skinny and long-limbed, folded awkwardly on his knees. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a sleeveless red silk over-robe a size too wide for him, over a clean soft grey gauze robe with two collars and sleeves rolled, a narrow red sash wound twice and tied in a loose bow as if he was told how and never remembered, pale grey woven sandals at his knee. Hands and objects: a square bundle of grey cloth held open with ash in its folds, a wooden comb and a folded robe visible, his fingers on the knot. Background: a doorway of dark rock, a luminous orange dusk sky, rows of small round stones marking sleeping places on the ledge, a thin line of smoke from the village far below. Light: warm dusk glow from the upper left, deep orange at the horizon dyeing the top of his hair and the bundle's edges. Expression: a quick, eager smile with a flicker of uncertainty behind it, a boy split between two doors and charming both.

people.imagined: In the cooled lava among the standing dead she taps one marker with a tin ladle, saying the name under her breath; she has done it every day for years.
people.subject: The moment: among low black stone markers she taps the nearest with a tin ladle and turns her calm face to the viewer, saying a name under her breath as she has every day for years. Face: a broad, calm, plain face with a full chin and wide cheeks, brown skin smooth with a pair of deep dimples when she smiles, peaceful lowered eyelids, eyes that crease gently, a straight mouth, a wide forehead with two soft lines; no ornaments. Hair: black with a lot of grey, in a low bun under a faded pale-rose silk headcloth knotted at the back. Body: broad and solid, comfortable and slow. Clothing: a longer sleeveless dull-red silk over-robe with a hem dusted grey by ash from the lava, over soft grey gauze with two crossed collars, a clean pale grey silk sash tied over it, soft cloth shoes; no scars on her arms, which are brown and unmarked. Hands and objects: a long-handled tin ladle with a dented bowl in her right hand, raised to touch a rough black stone post; behind her more posts in rows. Power: a gentle warm ember glow in each marker's crack, tiny motes like fireflies hovering above the stones. Background: cooled black lava with rows of upright rough dark stones the height of a child, each with a wisp of dry grass in a crack at its foot, under a luminous pale orange evening sky and mist. Light: low warm spirit-light from the upper left, her shadow long and soft over the lava, a thin warm rim on the ladle. Expression: a calm, content face, soft eyes resting on the markers, a small settled line at the mouth, as at a daily habit.

people.imagined: He turns his chin to show the scar and tells again the story of the palace fan; his bare arm is out and he is flexing it for show.
people.subject: The moment: he lifts his chin and turns his face sideways to show a scar on the jaw, grinning with contempt as he tells again the story of the palace fan. Face (most important: a pale curved scar across the chin, wide and plain): a sharp handsome face with a cocky tilted chin, a long pale scar running from the left corner of his mouth across the point of his chin, narrow arrogant eyes with a gleam, thick dark eyebrows, a wide cruel half-grin; clear tanned skin, a long straight nose, one front tooth slightly longer than the other. Hair: black, in a high tail with a red silk cord and a small red-jade clasp, a shaved patch behind one ear. Body: athletic, broad in the shoulders, flexed. Clothing: a sleeveless red silk over-robe cut to the ribs with embroidered flame borders over layered ember gauze with two collars crossed, the right arm bare with five pale scar lines from wrist to shoulder and a sixth just begun and pink, a strip of red silk tied round the upper arm like a trophy, a bound wrist wrap, a red silk sash tied in a loop at the belt with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right fist raised and flexed in front of the chest. Power: a bright ember-red aura crackles round the fist, sparks drifting up. Background: dark vent rock in mist and an orange haze; a line of younger disciples sits blurred along the rock behind him, watching. Light: warm glow from the upper left, a hard bright highlight across the scar and the top of the fist, eyes shining with pleasure. Expression: a grin held a beat too long, chin high, one brow arched, looking down his nose at the viewer.

people.imagined: He has just climbed a few steps and sits on the landing to catch his breath, blue shirt hanging loose on thin arms; an angry blister on one arm.
people.subject: The moment: he sits on a stone step a little out of breath, looking up at the viewer with a gentle tired smile. Face: a thin, pale young face with a long narrow nose, large soft brown eyes with dark rings under them, a mild open mouth, faint sweat at the temples; slightly large ears pink at the edges, thin dry lips, a faint spatter of freckles over the bridge of his nose. Hair: black, short and soft, parted to one side. Body: slight and narrow, thin wrists. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: an over-large pale sky-blue silk under-robe, faded soft, with a small neat patch on the shoulder, two collars crossed at the neck, sleeves rolled twice and slipping down; over it a short sleeveless red silk tunic with the hall's red sash tied twice at the waist and hanging loose over his narrow hips; on his right forearm a pink blister mark in the shape of a hand. Hands and objects: both hands on his knees, thin wrists showing; a small water gourd on a silk cord at his shoulder. Power: none beyond a very faint ember-warm shimmer at the blister. Background: a long stair of cooled pale-grey lava rising behind him in hazy mist, a few pale grey flowers in the cracks, a thin plume of steam far off. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left; the hazy air drains colour from everything beyond him so his blue robe is the brightest thing in the frame. Expression: a gentle tired smile, lips slightly parted for breath, brows soft, a damp sheen at the temples.

people.imagined: On the wharf at home she grins at a rude sailor, a chipped front tooth showing, her fists up and ready.
people.subject: The moment: on the wharf at home she grins widely straight at the viewer with her fists raised at chest height in a rough boxer's guard, answering a rude sailor. Face (most important: a chipped front tooth, a clear triangular gap in the upper left incisor, showing in the grin): a sunburned round face with freckles, bright dark eyes narrowed with laughter, strong level dark brows with a split in the left one, a short snub nose, a faint white scar across the chin. Hair: black and thick, in a single messy tail tied with red silk string, loose strands blown across her face. Body: short and stocky with thick arms, braced on a wide stance. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short sleeveless red silk over-robe cut at the hip with a slim dark flame border along the hem, over soft ember gauze with two crossed collars, bare strong arms with a bruise on one, a red silk sash tied in a harbour rope knot, a bracelet of ten polished wooden beads on the left wrist. Hands and objects: both fists up, knuckles forward. Power: none, only a faint warm glow in her knuckles. Background: a luminous blue harbour sky crossed by tall masts in pale diagonals, a wooden bollard, a coil of thick rope on a low wall. Light: bright silvery sea-light from the upper left, the glare lighting the underside of her chin and the white edge of the chipped tooth. Expression: a wide, cocky, stubborn grin, chin lifted, eyes dancing, a girl who likes a fight and likes the crowd even more.

people.imagined: He sits on a sack of rice at the Lower Mouth, turning his hands over in the light; the soot on his fingertips will not wash out and he keeps it that way.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a sack of rice at the Lower Mouth he holds up his hands, palms toward himself, studying the black on his fingertips, then looks at the viewer sideways, eyes narrowed. Face: a smooth sly young face, narrow slightly slanted dark eyes with a gleam, a thin pointed nose, a thin mouth with one corner up, a small black beard patch under the lip and the faint shadow of a first moustache; pale smooth skin. Hair: black, combed back and tied with a red silk cord, one lock hanging by the cheek. Body: slender and wiry, loose-shouldered. Clothing: a sleeveless red silk over-robe cut at the ribs with fine flame borders; beneath it the stiff-collared grey silk robe of the palace's servants shows at the neck, its sleeves cut off at the elbow, the hall's red silk sash knotted over it in a careful palace knot with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: ten fingertips black with palace soot, in the frame and plain against the pale palms; on his knee a small cloth sack of rice. Power: faint ember-red motes curl around his fingertips. Background: sacks of rice stacked in a rough pile in mist, above them the dark rock arch of the Lower Mouth with a spirit-lantern hung from a hook, a faint orange glow. Light: warm glow from the upper left; the soot seems darker against it, almost blue at the edges. Expression: a half-hidden smirk at one corner of the mouth, eyes narrowed and glancing sideways, a charming and not quite honest face.

people.imagined: He lies dozing at the edge of the charcoal pit in the afternoon, hat tipped on his face, in a neat brown work coat; one eye cracks open when the cooks' boy shouts.
people.subject: The moment: in the afternoon he leans back half asleep on a heap of black charcoal sacks, a hat tipped back and one eye open at the viewer, as the cooks' boy shouts. Face: a round, kind, lazy face, fat cheeks smudged with soot and soft creases, a short wide bulbous shiny nose, small contented squinting eyes, a broad slack mouth, grey stubble following the jaw. Hair: grey and thinning, under a wide conical straw hat. Body: stout, a round belly, loose. Clothing: he is a servant and a mortal, so plain but clean: a neat dark-brown hemp coat with rolled sleeves and a green cloth patch over one elbow, black at the cuffs from charcoal, a row of tiny scorch holes along the left sleeve, a wide dull-green cloth belt, grey trousers tied at the ankle; no sash of the hall; a clay pipe tucked behind one ear. Hands and objects: arms folded across the belly, black fingers; a short-handled wooden rake leaning on his shoulder. Power: none. Background: a smoky charcoal pit in soft mist, black mounds with a thin spiral of smoke, two crows on the edge, a pale blue-gold sky. Light: soft glowing smoky afternoon light from the upper left, a warm grey-gold haze, his shadow soft and wide. Expression: a lazy half-smile, one eye cracked open and the other shut, the face slack and comfortable under the tipped hat.

people.imagined: Memorial of the boy who asked to sit first: eager, bare-armed, before the sitting, in the vent village's dawn.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an eager boy at dawn on the day of the first sitting. Face: a young round face, wide-open dark eyes, thick black brows, a firm young jaw, a bright, brave, impatient smile, a smear of ash on one cheek; smooth fresh skin, bright teeth, a few freckles dusted across the bridge of his nose. Hair: black, in a plain topknot with a red silk cord and a small red-jade pin. Body: a lean, strong boy with broad shoulders, bare arms with no scars yet. Clothing: a new sleeveless red silk over-robe still showing its fold lines across the chest, flame borders in fresh thread, over ember gauze with two crossed collars, a new red silk sash still stiff and neatly knotted; bare arms smooth and unscarred; a short cord of red thread tied round his wrist for luck. Hands and objects: both hands pressed together in front of his chest in an oath gesture; before him on the ground a plain black stone rests on a folded cloth. Power: a faint ember glimmer about his hands, the glow of a first sitting not yet begun. Background: a soft pale dawn sky and mist, low dark houses of the vent village rising behind him with a single thread of smoke. Light: warm pale gold from the upper left, fading like old paint; yellowing and dark edges heaviest at the corners, his face the clearest part. Expression: a bright, eager face, wide eyes and parted lips leaning forward, a boy who cannot wait, rendered soft and faded.

people.imagined: Memorial of the best fighter of her day on the autumn of 1162, standing at the vent's mouth about to go in, hands steady, hair half undone for the rite.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of the best fighter of her day at the lip of a vent, face lifted, about to go in, her hair half undone for the rite. Face: a strong, proud face with sharp cheekbones, a long jaw, thick straight brows, fierce dark eyes, a firm mouth, lines of resolve at the brow; tanned skin, strong even teeth, and on her neck a pale ripple of old burn below the jaw. Hair: long black hair with two white streaks, half unbound, the rest in a tight red-corded knot crowned with a slim red-jade hairpin. Body: tall and strong, straight shoulders. Clothing: an elder's richest dress: a sleeveless deep-red brocade over-robe cut at the knee with gold flame embroidery over layered ember gauze with three crossed collars, her bare arms white and braided with dense pale scar lines to the shoulder, a heavy red silk sash tied tight with a jade pendant, a plain dark-red cord round her forehead. Hands and objects: both hands open at her sides, palms forward; at her throat a small carved red-stone bead on a silk cord. Power: a strong ember-red aura streams upward from her shoulders, sparks and motes rising with the column of orange light. Background: dark ash-grey rock, the rough lip of the vent curving behind her, thin streamers of heat, a column of orange spirit-light rising at the left. Light: orange from the lower left fading to old-silk yellow; the edges brown and cracked like old silk, the glow dulled to faded amber. Expression: a calm, lifted face, steady eyes and a firm still mouth, jaw set and no trace of fear, rendered soft and faded.
